mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_teacher_ai_config WHERE teacher_user_id=#{teacherUserId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_teacher_ai_config (teacher_user_id,provider_code,model_name,endpoint_url,api_key_ciphertext,api_key_hint,enabled,create_time,update_time) VALUES (#{teacherUserId},#{providerCode},#{modelName},#{endpointUrl},#{apiKeyCiphertext},#{apiKeyHint},#{enabled},NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider_code=VALUES(provider_code),model_name=VALUES(model_name), endpoint_url=VALUES(endpoint_url),api_key_ciphertext=VALUES(api_key_ciphertext), api_key_hint=VALUES(api_key_hint),enabled=VALUES(enabled),update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_practical_ai_job WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND teacher_user_id=#{teacherUserId}
SELECT * FROM biz_practical_ai_job WHERE job_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') ORDER BY job_id
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_practical_ai_job SET job_status=#{jobStatus}, start_time=COALESCE(#{startTime},start_time), finish_time=#{finishTime}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, heartbeat_time=NOW(), current_result_id=CASE WHEN #{jobStatus} IN ('PAUSED','CANCELLED','COMPLETED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED') THEN NULL ELSE current_result_id END WHERE job_id=#{jobId}

UPDATE biz_practical_ai_job SET preparation_status=#{preparationStatus}, comparison_pages_json=#{comparisonPagesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_message=#{errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, heartbeat_time=NOW() WHERE job_id=#{jobId}
UPDATE biz_practical_ai_job SET heartbeat_time=NOW(), current_result_id=#{currentResultId,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE job_id=#{jobId}

UPDATE biz_practical_ai_job job SET success_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_practical_ai_result r WHERE r.job_id=job.job_id AND r.result_status='SUCCESS'), failed_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_practical_ai_result r WHERE r.job_id=job.job_id AND r.result_status='FAILED') WHERE job_id=#{jobId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_practical_ai_result WHERE job_id=#{jobId} ORDER BY result_id
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_practical_ai_result SET result_status=#{resultStatus},suggested_score=#{suggestedScore}, scoring_details_json=#{scoringDetailsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR},evidence_json=#{evidenceJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, confidence=#{confidence},provider_request_id=#{providerRequestId},prompt_tokens=#{promptTokens}, completion_tokens=#{completionTokens},error_message=#{errorMessage},finish_time=#{finishTime}, processing_stage=#{processingStage},stage_updated_time=NOW(),duration_ms=#{durationMs} WHERE result_id=#{resultId} AND practical_version_id=#{practicalVersionId} AND result_status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE biz_practical_ai_result SET result_status='PROCESSING',processing_stage=#{processingStage},processing_started_time=NOW(), stage_updated_time=NOW(),finish_time=NULL,error_message=NULL,attempt_count=attempt_count+1 WHERE result_id=#{resultId} AND result_status='PENDING'
UPDATE biz_practical_ai_result SET processing_stage=#{processingStage},stage_updated_time=NOW() WHERE result_id=#{resultId} AND result_status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE biz_practical_ai_result SET result_status='PENDING',processing_stage='WAITING',processing_started_time=NULL, stage_updated_time=NOW(),error_message=NULL,finish_time=NULL WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND result_status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE biz_practical_ai_result SET result_status='PENDING',suggested_score=NULL,scoring_details_json=NULL, evidence_json=NULL,confidence=NULL,provider_request_id=NULL,prompt_tokens=NULL,completion_tokens=NULL, error_message=NULL,finish_time=NULL,processing_stage='WAITING',processing_started_time=NULL, stage_updated_time=NOW(),duration_ms=NULL WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND result_status='FAILED'

UPDATE biz_practical_ai_result SET result_status=#{resultStatus},error_message=#{errorMessage},finish_time=#{finishTime}, processing_stage=CASE WHEN #{resultStatus}='CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE processing_stage END, stage_updated_time=NOW(),duration_ms=CASE WHEN processing_started_time IS NULL THEN duration_ms ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,processing_started_time,#{finishTime}) DIV 1000 END WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND result_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_teacher_practical_reference_answer (teacher_user_id,dept_id,lesson_id,question_id,original_file_name,resource_path,file_extension, mime_type,file_size,sha256,create_time,update_time) VALUES (#{teacherUserId},#{deptId},#{lessonId},#{questionId},#{originalFileName},#{resourcePath}, #{fileExtension},#{mimeType},#{fileSize},#{sha256},NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reference_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(reference_id), original_file_name=VALUES(original_file_name),resource_path=VALUES(resource_path), file_extension=VALUES(file_extension),mime_type=VALUES(mime_type),file_size=VALUES(file_size), sha256=VALUES(sha256),update_time=NOW()
